# OSGovt (Open County Portal)

> Free, open-source website software for counties, cities and special districts: services and offices, meetings and notices, property records search with free copies, online payments, a counter point of sale, online forms, public information requests, and a free open API for all public data. Built to meet WCAG 2.1 AA. GNU AGPL-3.0; no license fees. Version 1.0.0.

## Pages

- [Home](https://osgovt.com/): what it does, run it locally in three commands
- [For officials](https://osgovt.com/for-officials/): what it costs, what happens to what you have now, who controls it, decisions, timeline, procurement
- [For IT and implementers](https://osgovt.com/for-it/): server size, install, backups, updates, migration, conformance suite
- [Open data and API](https://osgovt.com/open-data/): the free API, bulk files and DCAT-US catalog every installation publishes

## Try it

- [Demo county (Utopia County, fictional)](https://utopia.osgovt.com), with its own guide at https://utopia.osgovt.com/llms.txt
- Local copy: `git clone https://github.com/OSGovt/open-county-portal.git && cd open-county-portal && ./deploy/local/start.sh`

## Source and documentation

- Repository: https://github.com/OSGovt/open-county-portal

- Releases: https://github.com/OSGovt/open-county-portal/releases
